FORM.notes: source note: 一般稱女性長輩為 baybudan 但為表示親暱亦可稱 tina (mother), 同理, 稱男性長輩為 baqi 表示親暱則稱 tama (father). 故此處英譯為 dear aunt 。

S.FORM: yauiku tazian ayi tamaisuan tina haw.
S.PHON: jauiku ta[z|r]ian aji tamaisuan tina haw
S.FORM: yauiku tazian ayi tamaisuan tina haw.
S.PHON: jauiku ta[z|r]ian aji tamaisuan tina haw
S.TRANSL: 我在阿姨你這邊.
I'm here at your place, my dear aunt.

S.FORM: haw.
haw.
S.TRANSL: 嗯.
Yeah.

S.FORM: mawtuiku timaisuan.
mawtuiku timaisuan.
S.TRANSL: 我來到你家.
I came to your place.

S.FORM: ngidiku ipil tu masangay a zau utuz zinna nani.
S.PHON: ŋiɮiku ipir tu masaŋaj a [z|r]au utu[z|r] [z|r]inna nani
S.FORM: ngidiku ipil tu masangay a zau utuz zinna nani.
S.PHON: ŋiɮiku ipir tu masaŋaj a [z|r]au utu[z|r] [z|r]inna nani
S.TRANSL: 他(某位台大學生)說＂我想要聽聽有關從前地震的事＂.
He (an NTU student) said, 'I want to hear something about the earthquake in the past.'

S.FORM: naquni wawayta nazau na utuz tazian ta pakteRungan zinku timaisu nani.
S.PHON: naquni wawajta na[z|r]au na utu[z|r] ta[z|r]ian ta paktəʁuŋan [z|r]inku timaisu nani
S.FORM: naquni wawayta nazau na utuz tazian ta pakteRungan zinku timaisu nani.
S.PHON: naquni wawajta na[z|r]au na utu[z|r] ta[z|r]ian ta paktəʁuŋan [z|r]inku timaisu nani
S.TRANSL: 我跟你說,＂新社這裡的地震情形是如何＂.
I said to you, 'How was the earthquake here in PakteRung?'

FORM.notes: source note: qa-qaqa aiku timaisuan: I am older than you. 我年紀比你大 | source note: sa-swani aiku timaisuan: I am younger than you. 我年紀比你小

S.FORM: naquni a aisu m qaqaqa supaR tu zau tu utuz zinku.
S.PHON: naquni a aisu m qaqaqa supaʁ tu [z|r]au tu utu[z|r] [z|r]inku
S.FORM: naquni a aisu m qaqaqa supaR tu zau tu utuz zinku.
S.PHON: naquni a aisu m qaqaqa supaʁ tu [z|r]au tu utu[z|r] [z|r]inku
S.TRANSL: 我想你不管如何年紀都比我長,應該知道有關地震的事.
I think that since you're older than me, anyhow you'd know something about the earthquake.

S.FORM: nayau sayzi Raynguanku qaya utuz ni X azu.
S.PHON: najau saj[z|r]i ʁajŋuanku qaja utu[z|r] ni * a[z|r]u
S.FORM: nayau sayzi Raynguanku qaya utuz ni X azu.
S.PHON: najau saj[z|r]i ʁajŋuanku qaja utu[z|r] ni * a[z|r]u
S.TRANSL: 那樣也許沒錯,但是我並不知道什麼有關地震的事情,好像...
That might be the case, but I know nothing about the earthquake, like..

S.FORM: eh m Raynguanku qaya yu.
eh m Raynguanku qaya yu.
S.TRANSL: 我也不知道耶.
I don't know, either.

S.FORM: pasyani niqasianemanku Raymazuqay zinku a.
pasyani niqasianemanku Raymazuqay zinku a.
S.TRANSL: 我也不知道往哪裡想,我想我很笨.
My thought wanders around, and I think I'm stupid.

FORM.notes: source note: qawanay aisu s<m>inap=ay, mana aizipna: 應該是你在掃地，怎麼變成是他。

S.FORM: u qawanayti aisu supaRay msanemay nani.
S.PHON: u qawanajti aisu supaʁaj msanəmaj nani
S.FORM: u qawanayti aisu supaRay msanemay nani.
S.PHON: u qawanajti aisu supaʁaj msanəmaj nani
S.TRANSL: 所以應該由比較知道而且也比較聰明的你(來說地震的故事).
So (the one who can tell us the story) should be you, who are both knowledgeable and smart.

S.FORM: qametansu snikawmaanna a zana utuz a yau.
S.PHON: qamətansu snikawmaanna a [z|r]ana utu[z|r] a jau
S.FORM: qametansu snikawmaanna a zana utuz a yau.
S.PHON: qamətansu snikawmaanna a [z|r]ana utu[z|r] a jau
S.TRANSL: 你記得他說的,那個地震的(事情).
You remember what he said about that earthquake.

S.FORM: Raynguanku aikuan.
Raynguanku aikuan.
S.TRANSL: 我真的不知道.
I really don't know.

S.FORM: aisu pasikawma ya.
aisu pasikawma ya.
S.TRANSL: 你來說吧.
(Come on), tell us the story.

S.FORM: nayau ya naquni a qeni utuzanta naquni qenasupaRansu zinku ya.
S.PHON: najau ja naquni a qəni utu[z|r]anta naquni qənasupaʁansu [z|r]inku ja
S.FORM: nayau ya naquni a qeni utuzanta naquni qenasupaRansu zinku ya.
S.PHON: najau ja naquni a qəni utu[z|r]anta naquni qənasupaʁansu [z|r]inku ja
S.TRANSL: 那樣啊,不過我還是覺得你應該是知道我們以前地震的事.
Well, but I still somehow think that you know something about the earthquake that happened to us in the past.

S.FORM: nani yaupama aimi tatebaRungan.
nani yaupama aimi tatebaRungan.
S.TRANSL: 嗯, (那是發生在)我們還住在TebaRung的時候.
Well, (that happened when) we still lived in TebaRung.

S.FORM: yau mutuz nani yauimi qman sataRbabi nani.
S.PHON: jau mutu[z|r] nani jauimi qman sataʁβaβi nani
S.FORM: yau mutuz nani yauimi qman sataRbabi nani.
S.PHON: jau mutu[z|r] nani jauimi qman sataʁβaβi nani
S.TRANSL: 我們那時候正在吃早餐,然後地震就來了.
When we were having breakfast, the earthquake happened.

FORM.notes: source note: bibiaq-an-ku sabaq: 我把稻穀弄得散落一地 | source note: t<m>ibuq 某物體落下 ; bibiaq 成群物體落下

S.FORM: yauti utuz a yau nianpa nizanna bibiaq na utuz a kaysin.
S.PHON: jauti utu[z|r] a jau nianpa ni[z|r]anna βiβiaq na utu[z|r] a kajsin
S.FORM: yauti utuz a yau nianpa nizanna bibiaq na utuz a kaysin.
S.PHON: jauti utu[z|r] a jau nianpa ni[z|r]anna βiβiaq na utu[z|r] a kajsin
S.TRANSL: 地震就來啦,然後地震就把所有的碗都震倒了,真是可惜阿.
The earthquake happened. It's a pity that all the bowls fell off due to the earthquake.

S.FORM: m ah nayau a utuz a yau masang.
S.PHON: m ah najau a utu[z|r] a jau masaŋ
S.FORM: m ah nayau a utuz a yau masang.
S.PHON: m ah najau a utu[z|r] a jau masaŋ
S.TRANSL: 從前的地震就是那樣.
The earthquake in the past is like that.

FORM.notes: source note: qaytis-an (<afraid-AN) <害怕-AN | source note: mawRat tu Ramaz qaitisan 玩火很危險 | source note: qaytisan siqay 蛇很危險

S.FORM: qaytisan qaya haw.
qaytisan qaya haw.
S.TRANSL: 很危險.
(It's) dangerous.

S.FORM: m nani unayti kwa masesebangti kwa peliyas tawian tap tapungkangan.
S.PHON: m nani unajti kwa masəsəβaŋti kwa pərijas tawian tap tapuŋkaŋan
S.FORM: m nani unayti kwa masesebangti kwa peliyas tawian tap tapungkangan.
S.PHON: m nani unajti kwa masəsəβaŋti kwa pərijas tawian tap tapuŋkaŋan
S.TRANSL: 洞穴那邊的懸崖很多都塌了.
Many cliffs near the cave collapsed.

S.FORM: m nayau kwa utuz a yau nani.
S.PHON: m najau kwa utu[z|r] a jau nani
S.FORM: m nayau kwa utuz a yau nani.
S.PHON: m najau kwa utu[z|r] a jau nani
S.TRANSL: 那時的地震就是那個樣子.
The earthquake was like that.

S.FORM: sinapawantiisu unay.
sinapawantiisu unay.
S.TRANSL: 那時你結婚了沒?
Were you married at that time?

S.FORM: m sanshijiu nian sinapawantiiku zinku u maipama.
S.PHON: m sanshijiu nian sinapawantiiku [z|r]inku u maipama
S.FORM: m sanshijiu nian sinapawantiiku zinku u maipama.
S.PHON: m sanshijiu nian sinapawantiiku [z|r]inku u maipama
S.TRANSL: (民國)三十九年 ... 我想我結婚了,還是還沒呢?
In 1950 ... I think I was married, or maybe not?

S.FORM: X yauti.
X yauti.
S.TRANSL: 結了.
I was.

S.FORM: yauti haw.
yauti haw.
S.TRANSL: 結了嗎?
Were you?

S.FORM: sinapawanti na maipama sasunis.
sinapawanti na maipama sasunis.
S.TRANSL: 結婚了,但是還沒生小孩.
(I) was married, but hadn't had any children yet.

S.FORM: yaupamaimi tatebalonan yu 'nay Raya utuz.
S.PHON: jaupamaimi tatəβar*nan ju ʔnaj ʁaja utu[z|r]
S.FORM: yaupamaimi tatebalonan yu 'nay Raya utuz.
S.PHON: jaupamaimi tatəβar*nan ju ʔnaj ʁaja utu[z|r]
S.TRANSL: 大地震那時,我們還在tebalon那裡.
We were still at Tebalon when the strong earthquake happened.

FORM.notes: source note: *pama=iku kiya | source note: *kiya=iku pama | source note: m-utuz tu Raya=ay utuz. ‘The quake shakes strongly.’ 地震很強 | source note: m-uzan tu Raya=ay uzan. ‘It rains heavily.’ 雨下很大 | source note: m-uzan tu Raya ‘It rains heavily.’ 雨下很大。

S.FORM: aiku nani sepaRanku ya masang nayau a mutuz tu Raya 'nay nani kiyapamaiku.
S.PHON: aiku nani səpaʁanku ja masaŋ najau a mutu[z|r] tu ʁaja ʔnaj nani kijapamaiku
S.FORM: aiku nani sepaRanku ya masang nayau a mutuz tu Raya 'nay nani kiyapamaiku.
S.PHON: aiku nani səpaʁanku ja masaŋ najau a mutu[z|r] tu ʁaja ʔnaj nani kijapamaiku
S.TRANSL: 我知道以前那個大地震時,我還很小.
I was still very little when I knew the strong earthquake happened.

FORM.notes: source note: Rabtin=ti tasaw aiku tazian 我在這裡已經十年了。‘I’ve been here for ten years.’

S.FORM: Rabtinpama tasawku unay nani.
Rabtinpama tasawku unay nani.
S.TRANSL: 我那時年紀才十歲.
I was only ten years old then.

S.FORM: utulu betin yau usiwa tasaw a 'nay.
S.PHON: uturu βətin jau usiwa tasaw a ʔnaj
S.FORM: utulu betin yau usiwa tasaw a 'nay.
S.PHON: uturu βətin jau usiwa tasaw a ʔnaj
S.TRANSL: 那時是(民國)三十九年.

FORM.notes: source note: taRbabi 早上 morning; smuRap 清晨 early morning | source note: azu sanu-su = azu ni-sanu-an-su

S.FORM: nayau azu sanusu smuRap ya utuz a yau.
S.PHON: najau a[z|r]u sanusu smuʁap ja utu[z|r] a jau
S.FORM: nayau azu sanusu smuRap ya utuz a yau.
S.PHON: najau a[z|r]u sanusu smuʁap ja utu[z|r] a jau
S.TRANSL: 正如你說的那樣,地震是(發生)在早上.
Like what you said, the earthquake (happened) in the early morning.

FORM.notes: source note: (mai)=pama=ita q<m>an sa-taRbabi 我們還沒吃早餐。 ‘We haven’t had breakfast yet.’ | source note: yau=pama=ita q<m>an sa-taRbabi 我們還在吃早餐。 ‘We’re still having breakfast.’ | source note: pun=ti=iku q<m>an sa-taRbabi 我已經吃過早餐。 ‘I finished having breakfast.’ | source note: pun=ti sa-taRbabi-an 早餐準備好了。 ‘Breakfast is ready.’ | source note: pun=ti=iku s<m>angi tu sa-taRbabi-an 我已經準備好早餐了。 ‘I finished making breakfast.’ | source note: sa-taRbabi-an-ku zau. 我早餐要吃這些。 ‘This is what I am going to eat for breakfast.’

S.FORM: smuRap saizi qmanpamaita sataRbabi.
smuRap saizi qmanpamaita sataRbabi.
S.TRANSL: 是早上沒錯,(因為)我們(那時候)還在吃早餐.
It was in the early morning. We were still eating breakfast.

FORM.notes: source note: putiamling = pa-tiamling = pa-salil 放網 to toss the net; *pu-salil | source note: zau sa-pa-salil-an-ku 這是我要放網的(e.g.漁網) This is the fish net that I’ll toss. | source note: zau sa-salil-an-ku 這是我樣放網的(e.g.地方) This is the place where I toss the net. | source note: zau sa-sangi-an-ku tu salil 這是我要做漁網的(e.g.網線之類的東西) This is the material that I am making the fish net with.

S.FORM: utuz a yau baqiku matiw sa lazing putiamling miza ya Raybaut aizipna tikinzay.
S.PHON: utu[z|r] a jau βaqiku matiw sa ra[z|r]iŋ putiamriŋ mi[z|r]a ja ʁajβaut ai[z|r]ipna tikin[z|r]aj
S.FORM: utuz a yau baqiku matiw sa lazing putiamling miza ya Raybaut aizipna tikinzay.
S.PHON: utu[z|r] a jau βaqiku matiw sa ra[z|r]iŋ putiamriŋ mi[z|r]a ja ʁajβaut ai[z|r]ipna tikin[z|r]aj
S.TRANSL: 我阿公去海邊放網捕魚
My grandpa went to the sea to net and catch fish.

S.FORM: m kinawsa nayau.
m kinawsa nayau.
S.TRANSL: 他們,和sinzay兩個人.
They two ... together with Sinzay.

S.FORM: seqawalu qumni unay mana Raynguanku ka.
S.PHON: səqawaru qumni unaj mana ʁajŋuanku ka
S.FORM: seqawalu qumni unay mana Raynguanku ka.
S.PHON: səqawaru qumni unaj mana ʁajŋuanku ka
S.TRANSL: 那是夏天還是什麼時候?我怎麼不記得了?
Was it summer, or sometime else? How come I can't remember?

FORM.notes: source note: bangngel nizu ta-seqawalu-an 颱風都在夏天。

S.FORM: seqawalu seqawalu yu.
seqawalu seqawalu yu.
S.TRANSL: 是夏天.
It was summer.

S.FORM: seqawalu haw.
seqawalu haw.
S.TRANSL: 是夏天對吧?
It was summer, wasn't it?

S.FORM: m nani seqawalu.
m nani seqawalu.
S.TRANSL: 是夏天.
It was summer.

FORM.notes: source note: tuRabi wi pa-salil ‘晚上去放網。’ ‘throw the fish nets at night’

S.FORM: tuRabi ya wi nani taRbabi suna su sudatpa tu salilna nani.
S.PHON: tuʁaβi ja wi nani taʁβaβi suna su suɮatpa tu sarirna nani
S.FORM: tuRabi ya wi nani taRbabi suna su sudatpa tu salilna nani.
S.PHON: tuʁaβi ja wi nani taʁβaβi suna su suɮatpa tu sarirna nani
S.TRANSL: 那個晚上去,早上收網.
(They) left at night and retrieved their net in the morning.

FORM.notes: source note: qiwiqiw-ika ‘Roar!’ 咆哮！ | source note: yau a ipaz-na tu qiwiqiw=ay ‘They roared left and right.’ 他們強烈咆哮。

S.FORM: kinawsa ti kinzay yau a ipazna tu e iza u 'nay 'nay X qiwiqiway a X pelunana.
S.PHON: kinawsa ti kin[z|r]aj jau a ipa[z|r]na tu ə i[z|r]a u ʔnaj ʔnaj * qiwiqiwaj a * pərunana
S.FORM: kinawsa ti kinzay yau a ipazna tu e iza u 'nay 'nay X qiwiqiway a X pelunana.
S.PHON: kinawsa ti kin[z|r]aj jau a ipa[z|r]na tu ə i[z|r]a u ʔnaj ʔnaj * qiwiqiwaj a * pərunana
S.TRANSL: 他們左右划槳.
They roared left and right.

S.FORM: ipaz masang.
ipaz masang.
S.TRANSL: 以前的竹筏就是那樣.
The rafts in the past were like that.

FORM.notes: source note: mana smani aizipna 他不知怎麼搞的

S.FORM: n ya tu mana smani qaya mutuz unay nani.
S.PHON: n ja tu mana smani qaja mutu[z|r] unaj nani
S.FORM: n ya tu mana smani qaya mutuz unay nani.
S.PHON: n ja tu mana smani qaja mutu[z|r] unaj nani
S.TRANSL: 也不知道那個地震...
Not knowing the earthquake...

FORM.notes: source note: qena-lepaw-an-ku 我蓋過房子的地方/我曾住過的地方。The place where I built the house/the place where I lived.

S.FORM: wiiku pasazui ta ngayauan na qani iza u na lepawan na qaniisaku tayan kwa taqawRian.
S.PHON: wiiku pasa[z|r]ui ta ŋajauan na qani i[z|r]a u na rəpawan na qaniisaku tajan kwa taqawʁian
S.FORM: wiiku pasazui ta ngayauan na qani iza u na lepawan na qaniisaku tayan kwa taqawRian.
S.PHON: wiiku pasa[z|r]ui ta ŋajauan na qani i[z|r]a u na rəpawan na qaniisaku tajan kwa taqawʁian
S.TRANSL: 我轉到isaku他們以前的家的前面,靠海的那個地方.
I turned toward the front of the house where Isaku once lived, toward the place near the sea.

S.FORM: nani maqayta ya betu a yau Rayaay.
S.PHON: nani maqajta ja βətu a jau ʁajaaj
S.FORM: nani maqayta ya betu a yau Rayaay.
S.PHON: nani maqajta ja βətu a jau ʁajaaj
S.TRANSL: 看到那個大石頭.
(I) saw the the big rock.

S.FORM: yautiimu tayan ya yaupamaimi ta mutuz X.
S.PHON: jautiimu tajan ja jaupamaimi ta mutu[z|r] *
S.FORM: yautiimu tayan ya yaupamaimi ta mutuz X.
S.PHON: jautiimu tajan ja jaupamaimi ta mutu[z|r] *
S.TRANSL: 地震那時,你們已經在那邊了嗎?
Had you been there when the earthquake happened?

S.FORM: yaupamaimi ta tayan ta zana kyukay tangi ta zana e taqsian.
S.PHON: jaupamaimi ta tajan ta [z|r]ana kjukaj taŋi ta [z|r]ana ə taqsian
S.FORM: yaupamaimi ta tayan ta zana kyukay tangi ta zana e taqsian.
S.PHON: jaupamaimi ta tajan ta [z|r]ana kjukaj taŋi ta [z|r]ana ə taqsian
S.TRANSL: 我們還在現在教會的那個地方,在學校那邊.
We were still at the place where the church is located now, near the school.

S.FORM: XXXX zinku ya taqsian ni liangu.
XXXX zinku ya taqsian ni liangu.
S.TRANSL: 學校,就在現在liangu住的那邊.
School, beside (the place where) liangu lives now, I think.

S.FORM: na usa usa.
na usa usa.
S.TRANSL: 不不不.
No, no, no.

S.FORM: tazianpamaimi ta izaan u tazana taqsian tatuqeban na taqsian tangi.
S.PHON: ta[z|r]ianpamaimi ta i[z|r]aan u ta[z|r]ana taqsian tatuqəβan na taqsian taŋi
S.FORM: tazianpamaimi ta izaan u tazana taqsian tatuqeban na taqsian tangi.
S.PHON: ta[z|r]ianpamaimi ta i[z|r]aan u ta[z|r]ana taqsian tatuqəβan na taqsian taŋi
S.TRANSL: 我們還在那個...那個...現在的學校的後面.
We were still at the ... the rear of the school.

S.FORM: X takyukay tangi X ta qani tina bayi tipilawan tuqeban.
S.PHON: * takjukaj taŋi * ta qani tina βaji tipirawan tuqəβan
S.FORM: X takyukay tangi X ta qani tina bayi tipilawan tuqeban.
S.PHON: * takjukaj taŋi * ta qani tina βaji tipirawan tuqəβan
S.TRANSL: 在現在的教會,Pilaw阿姨家的後面.
(At the place where) the church is now. At the rear of Pilaw's (house).

FORM.notes: source note: pani-aswan 已故的aswan(對死者的尊稱) the late - ; an expression referring to the dead

S.FORM: o qaniiza qaya qaniahun atu ti iza kwa qanialan ti aswan.
S.PHON: * qanii[z|r]a qaja qaniahun atu ti i[z|r]a kwa qaniaran ti aswan
S.FORM: o qaniiza qaya qaniahun atu ti iza kwa qanialan ti aswan.
S.PHON: * qanii[z|r]a qaja qaniahun atu ti i[z|r]a kwa qaniaran ti aswan
S.TRANSL: 也是在那個Ahun還有那個Alan和Asuan (家的後面).
Also (at the rear of) ... Ahun's, and ... Alan's and Aswan's.

S.FORM: e yau bayi tipaytawku.
e yau bayi tipaytawku.
S.TRANSL: 還有Paytawku (的家).
And of Paytawku's.
